By card (copies of each non-starter card, covariates book and upgrades, HC1 se), nets minus heuristic: Demon Form -7.54 (1.23) on the product nets (heuristic +2.35, nets -5.19), -6.2 to -9.2 in every group; no other card below 2 se; FTL +3.49 (1.33), Brutality +2.38, Inflame +1.94 in the nets' favour. Two turns deep the Demon Form stratum gains +6.4 to +10.4 HP over the one-turn 10-29 net. Generated bench (elite+boss, 3 copies, 10-29 net minus heuristic wins, se over cells): turn start -0.292 (0.049), turn end -0.061 (0.054), card played +0.005 (0.047), original Demon Form -0.140 (0.033), original Metallicize -0.083 (0.030). Code read: the net's rows carry Demon Form (OwnerTurnStart x apply Strength to me), a combination no training game held on the player's side; the one-turn leaf is the state at the next turn's draw, before turn-start hooks, so its Strength never lands inside the search: seen and not learned, payoff outside the leaf. Disagreements with cause/unseen-cards-half-edge: FTL differs by 3.49 HP (the fact says no card but Demon Form beyond 2.4); its bench se are per fight, smaller than per cell.
